programme.title: Quai d'Orsay
programme.desc: Arthur Vlaminck est un jeune énarque, nouveau venu au Quai d'Orsay. Il a été embauché pour écrire les discours d'Alexandre Taillard de Vorms, le charismatique ministre des Affaires étrangères. Ce dernier est un tourbillon, et le jeune homme peut à peine prononcer un mot face à lui. Lorsque le politicien, très occupé, daigne lui consacrer de brefs instants, il jette un coup d'oeil aux textes que le jeune conseiller lui a concoctés. Puis, sans tenir compte de l'opinion du rédacteur, il les corrige comme bon lui semble. Le directeur du cabinet du ministre sert de guide au jeune homme et lui apprend notamment à composer avec le tempérament fougueux de Taillard.. programme.title: Jeff Panacloc : A la poursuite de Jean-Marc
programme.desc: Retenu par l'armée française dans une base secrète, Jean-Marc, un véritable spécialiste de l'évasion, parvient une nouvelle fois à s'enfuir, semant la panique parmi les membres du personnel présent sur place. Et pour cause ! Jean-Marc est une surprenante peluche vivante et relativement peu commode. Immédiatement lancés à ses trousses, les militaires ne parviennent pourtant pas à localiser leur cible qui a trouvé refuge auprès de Jeff, un sympathique jeune homme qui passait dans le coin. Amadoué par son nouveau compagnon, Jeff accepte de le prendre sous son aile et de le cacher malgré les risques encourus.. programme.title: Alita : Battle Angel
programme.desc: Alita se réveille, amnésique, dans une chambre d'enfant. Elle découvre avec stupeur qu'elle est vivante et qu'elle a un corps. Etonnée, elle tente de se lever et marche difficilement jusqu'au miroir où elle se voit pour la première fois. Elle a été trouvée par le docteur Ido. A Iron City, elle se découvre des capacités physiques incroyables et rencontre Hugo, lequel est fasciné par le corps en ivoire d'Alita. Le jeune homme avoue qu'il travaille de temps en temps pour Ido et s'en va en lui promettant de la revoir. Alors qu'elle se pose des questions sur ses origines, elle est bientôt pourchassée par Vector et ses sbires.. programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: En 1954, une femme placée en centre de détention psychiatrique à Shutter Island disparaît. Elle s'appelle Rachel Solando et est une meurtrière extrêmement dangereuse. Deux officiers du corps fédéral des marshals, Teddy Daniels et Chuck Aule, viennent enquêter sur place. Ils découvrent l'île humide et brumeuse au large de Boston où se trouve cet hôpital-prison d'un genre très particulier. Très vite, Teddy Daniels comprend que le personnel de l'établissement cache quelque chose. Seul indice dont il dispose : un bout de papier sur lequel est griffonnée une suite de chiffres entrecoupée de lettres.. programme.title: Le cas Richard Jewell
programme.desc: Lors des Jeux olympiques d'été à Atlanta en 1996, Richard Jewell, un agent de sécurité sans histoire, découvre une bombe au Centennial Olympic Park, où ont lieu des activités culturelles en soirée. La bombe explose. Deux personnes meurent, des dizaines d'autres sont blessées. Jewell, dont la vigilance a permis de sauver de nombreuses vies, est célébré dans les médias. Mais, l'enquêteur Tom Shaw du FBI est convaincu que Jewell a fabriqué et déposé la bombe. La journaliste Kathy Scruggs de l'"Atlanta Journal-Constitution" commence à remettre en cause la version officielle. Dès lors, la vie de Richard Jewell, soutenu par sa mère et par son avocat Watson Bryant, tourne au cauchemar.. programme.title: Frères

Le quinquagénaire ne tarde pas à retrouver son aîné, quelque peu déprimé et parti se ressourcer dans le Grand Nord canadien. Michel et Patrice partagent un incroyable secret. En effet, en 1948, tous deux avaient été abandonnés par leur mère, incapable de les élever. Livrés à eux-mêmes, les deux garçons, alors âgés de 5 et 7 ans, s'étaient alors cachés dans une forêt où ils avaient vécu seuls pendant sept ans, à l'abri des regards.. programme.title: Blue & Compagnie
programme.desc: Bea, 12 ans, découvre avec stupéfaction qu'elle semble dotée d'un don étrange. En effet, la préadolescente se rend compte qu'elle possède la capacité de voir les amis imaginaires qui ont été oubliés par leurs compagnons humains une fois ceux-ci devenus grands. Désormais délaissés, les pauvres hères poursuivent leur existence sans but, malheureux d'avoir été abandonnés après avoir rempli leurs missions. Bea ne tarde pas à comprendre que Cal, un voisin, a le même pouvoir qu'elle. programme.title: Rendez-vous avec Pol Pot
programme.desc: 1978. Depuis trois ans, le Cambodge, désormais devenu le Kampuchéa démocratique, est sous le joug de Pol Pot et des Khmers rouges. Le pays est économiquement exsangue, et près de deux millions de Cambodgiens ont péri dans un génocide encore inexplicablement tu. Trois Français ont accepté l'invitation du régime, espérant obtenir un entretien exclusif avec Pol Pot : une journaliste familière du pays, un reporter photographe et un intellectuel sympathisant de l'idéologie révolutionnaire. Mais la réalité qu'ils perçoivent sous la propagande et le traitement qui leur est réservé vont peu à peu faire basculer les certitudes de chacun.. programme.title: King's Land
programme.desc: Au XVIIIe siècle, au Danemark, Ludvig Kahlen, un capitaine sans fortune, s'aventure dans le Jutland, une contrée sauvage. Il espère y établir une colonie au nom du roi Frédéric VI et cultiver les landes afin d'obtenir un titre de noblesse. Mais Frederik de Schinkel, impitoyable seigneur de cette terre, ne l'entend pas de cette oreille et ne recule devant aucune extrémité pour contrecarrer les projets de Kahlen, qui doit également composer avec une terre aride réputée incultivable et des bandits qui rôdent aux alentours.. programme.title: Invincible
programme.desc: Athlète américain de haut niveau, Louie Zamperini est un coureur olympique médaillé qui n'échappe pas à la Seconde Guerre Mondiale. En 1942, l'avion qui le transporte lui et d'autres soldats s'écrase en mer tuant la quasi-totalité des membres de l'équipage. Zamperini et un autre rescapé réussissent néanmoins à survivre pendant quarante-sept jours à bord d'un canot de sauvetage avant d'être capturés par l'ennemi japonais. D'abord soignés à l'hôpital, ils sont bientôt transférés dans un camp de prisonniers de guerre où la célébrité de Zamperini lui porte préjudice. Conduit ensuite dans un nouveau camp à Tokyo, Louie Zamperini subit les sévices physiques et mentaux d'un gardien particulièrement violent.. programme.title: Mal de pierres
programme.desc: Dans un petit village du sud de la France, Gabrielle a le tort d'exprimer de façon passionnée ses émotions et ses sentiments. Ses parents la croyant folle, ils la marient contre son gré à José, un des ouvriers saisonniers de leur ferme, un homme patient et généreux. Malgré l'attention et l'amour qu'il lui porte, Gabrielle affirme qu'elle n'aimera jamais cet homme qui lui a été imposé. Tout bascule quand elle est envoyée en cure thermale en Savoie pour soigner ses calculs rénaux. Elle y rencontre André Sauvage, un lieutenant blessé qui revient de la guerre d'Indochine. Auprès de cet homme érudit Gabrielle redécouvre l'amour et la passion.. programme.title: Bruno Podalydes : Juste une mise au point
programme.desc:
Le portrait d'un cinéaste se dessine alors qu'il réagit aux images d'archives et extraits de films qui lui sont projetés, délivrant de nombreuses anecdotes de tournages et racontant avec humilité son parcours artistique
Bruno Podalydès revient sur son parcours et évoque ses influences et les défis rencontrés tout au long de sa carrière dans le processus créatif. En Streaming Sébastien Labadie - Réalisateur Raphaëlle Catteau - Réalisateur Jean-Marie Poiré - Intervenant.

programme.title: Sans jamais nous connaître
programme.desc: Scénariste discret, Adam vit seul dans son appartement situé en banlieue de Londres, dans un immeuble quasiment vidé de ses habitants. Un soir, le quadragénaire fait la connaissance de Harry, un de ses rares voisins, qui lui fait ouvertement des avances. Peu après cette troublante rencontre, Adam, en panne d'inspiration, décide de se rendre dans la maison de son enfance, là où il vivait avec ses parents, disparus trois décennies plus tôt dans un accident de la route. Arrivé sur place, il constate avec stupéfaction que ces derniers vivent inexplicablement toujours dans la demeure. Sous le choc, il se joint à eux pour le dîner.. programme.title: Le dernier loup
programme.desc: 1967, pendant la révolution culturelle chinoise. Chen Zhen, un jeune étudiant originaire de Pékin, est envoyé en Mongolie-Intérieure afin d'apprendre le chinois à une tribu de bergers nomades. Alors qu'il s'enfonce dans la steppe, Chen tombe nez à nez sur une bande de loups. Immédiatement fasciné par l'animal, il voudrait élever un petit. Il trouve un louveteau qu'il est obligé de cacher dans un trou pour ne pas éveiller les soupçons de la tribu. Alors que Chen et l'animal développent une belle relation, l'étudiant est démasqué par les villageois en colère. Pire, un officier du gouvernement veut éliminer l'espèce dans cette région.. programme.title: Le cinquième élément
programme.desc: Egypte, 1914. Des extraterrestres récupèrent quatre pierres magiques, symboles des quatre éléments, jadis confiées à des prêtres. Avant de partir, les extraterrestres promettent que dans 300 ans, ils rapporteront les précieux cailloux. Au XXIIIe siècle, alors qu'ils font route vers la Terre, ils sont anéantis par la planète du Mal. Les habitants de ce monde maléfique, les Mangalores, s'emparent des pierres et foncent vers la Terre. Le président Lindberg et ses conseillers se rendent rapidement à l'évidence : il n'existe aucun moyen de les arrêter. Une mutante, Leeloo, détient la clef du cinquième élément. Elle atterrit dans le taxi de Korben Dallas, qui la cache chez lui.. programme.title: Le prix de la loyauté
programme.desc: A New York, quatre policiers sont abattus au cours d'une banale affaire de drogue. Mais l'événement attire très rapidement l'attention des médias. En effet, plusieurs zones d'ombre posent question, notamment parce que les trafiquants semblaient prévenus de l'arrivée des agents. Francis Tierney senior, un patriarche de la police, demande à son fils Ray de se pencher sur cette affaire. Avec efficacité et idéalisme, Ray prend ce dossier à bras-le-corps. Il comprend soudain qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un simple fait divers : l'appartement où a eu lieu le crime appartenait en fait à un baron de la drogue. Pourrait-il s'agir d'une vengeance orchestrée par la mafia new-yorkaise ?.. programme.title: Mad Max : Fury Road
programme.desc: Depuis l'apocalypse nucléaire qui a détruit toute civilisation, ce qui reste de l'humanité s'entretue dans un monde désertique. Se tenant à l'écart de cette funeste agitation, Max Rockatansky est parvenu à survivre tant bien que mal. Un jour, il tombe entre les mains d'une bande de guerriers de la route dirigée par un dénommé Immortan Joe, potentat cruel qui règne sur des miséreux qu'il contrôle grâce à sa maîtrise des réserves d'eau potable. Lorsque l'impératrice Furiosa, un des lieutenants d'Immortan, s'enfuit en emmenant avec elle les femmes du tyran, une course-poursuite dantesque s'engage, dans laquelle Max se retrouve impliqué malgré lui.. programme.title: The Secret Man : Mark Felt
programme.desc: Mark Felt travaille depuis trente ans au sein du FBI. Il a gravi les échelons pour en devenir le numéro 2. C'est un modèle de courage, de probité et d'intégrité. Cet époux modèle est chargé de l'enquête sur cinq poseurs de micros pris en flagrant délit au sein du QG du parti démocrate à Washington. Voulant à tout pris faire la lumière sur cette affaire, il contacte Bob Woodward et Carl Bernstein, deux journalistes du "Washington Post" et leur donne toutes les informations dont il dispose. Un article sort et les pontes du FBI se demande qui est la taupe.. programme.title: Boutchou

Le couple n'imaginait pas l'attitude de leurs propres parents face à l'arrivée de leur fils. Paula et Roberto, les parents de Paul, et Odile et Raoul, ceux de Virginie, se livrent une guerre sans merci pour devenir le papi ou la mamie préféré de leur petit-fils et passer le plus de temps possible avec lui. Excédés par la situation, les jeunes parents décident de leur faire passer un test du grand-parent apte à s'occuper de leur enfant. Ils les obligent à partir ensemble en vacances, avec la nounou britannique Mary, et prouver ainsi qu'ils sont à la hauteur.. programme.title: Cocorico
programme.desc: Alors que leur fils François s'apprête à prendre Alice pour épouse, Nicole et Gérard se rendent au domaine des Bouvier-Sauvage, immense propriété familiale où vivent Catherine et Frédéric, les parents de la future mariée. Sur place, alors que les proches des deux fiancés font plus ample connaissance, François et Alice font une annonce qui surprend tout le monde. En effet, ils ont fait réaliser des tests ADN afin de déterminer précisément les origines de tous les proches présents à cette petite réunion. Pierre lui reproche d'être arrivée en retard, ce que d'aucuns jugent raciste. Or l'échange a été filmé et diffusé sur Internet. La direction de l'université demande au professeur de se racheter. programme.title: Le prix de la loyauté

En effet, plusieurs zones d'ombre posent question, notamment parce que les trafiquants semblaient prévenus de l'arrivée des agents. Francis Tierney senior, un patriarche de la police, demande à son fils Ray de se pencher sur cette affaire. Avec efficacité et idéalisme, Ray prend ce dossier à bras-le-corps. Il comprend soudain qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un simple fait divers : l'appartement où a eu lieu le crime appartenait en fait à un baron de la drogue. programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: 1889. Envoyée dans un village de la campagne française, Louise Violet, une institutrice idéaliste et ex-communarde, est chargée d'y imposer l'école de la République, devenue gratuite, laïque, et surtout obligatoire depuis le vote des lois Ferry. programme.title: The Secret Man : Mark Felt
programme.desc: Mark Felt travaille depuis trente ans au sein du FBI. Il a gravi les échelons pour en devenir le numéro 2. C'est un modèle de courage, de probité et d'intégrité. Cet époux modèle est chargé de l'enquête sur cinq poseurs de micros pris en flagrant délit au sein du QG du parti démocrate à Washington. Alors qu'il commence à y voir plus clair, la Maison-Blanche met un frein à ses investigations. Voulant à tout pris faire la lumière sur cette affaire, il contacte Bob Woodward et Carl Bernstein, deux journalistes du "Washington Post" et leur donne toutes les informations dont il dispose. Un article sort et les pontes du FBI se demande qui est la taupe.. programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Santa Misa
programme.desc: Transmisión de la Santa Misa. Celebración católica en la que se renueva el sacrificio del calvario y se celebra el sacramento de la eucaristía. Por medio de la consagración del pan y el vino, el sacerdote entrega el cuerpo y la sangre de Cristo a los fieles, para el perdón de los pecados y el fortalecimiento de la fe. Celebración de la liturgia de la palabra y la liturgia de la eucaristía en donde se buscar alabar, agradecer y celebrar a Dios y a Jesús, reflexionando a partir de la lectura de las Sagradas Escrituras.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly "1 Big Thing" commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in "Bad Beats." The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: NFL Matchup
programme.desc: An NFL Films production, "NFL Matchup" is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics -- the Xs and Os -- through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio.

programme.title: El quinto mandamiento
programme.desc: Un encuentro entre un profesor, Peter Farquhar, y un carismático estudiante, Ben Field, termina preparando el escenario para un complejo caso criminal.

programme.title: El sueño de Casandra
programme.desc: Una mujer seductora engaña a dos hermanos con problemas económicos, los lleva a experimentar una vida criminal y provoca una gran rivalidad entre ellos.

programme.title: Nosotras
programme.desc: Nina y Madeleine, dos mujeres jubiladas, están secretamente enamoradas desde hace décadas. Aunque de cara a los demás, no son más que dos vecinas, ellas vienen y van de una casa a la otra, compartiendo la ternura de una vida en común. Hasta que, un día, un suceso inesperado cambia su relación para siempre.

programme.title: Los bastardos de Pizzofalcone
programme.desc: Un niño fue secuestrado mientras visitaba un museo en Nápoles. Los Bastardos se deben enfrentar a una escalofriante historia de secuestro y chantaje.

programme.title: Vigil
programme.desc: Con embarcaciones hostiles que rastrean el submarino y con las comunicaciones cortadas, la tripulación del Vigil tiene que sortear esta crisis en soledad. Kirsten busca desesperadamente pistas para revelar el origen de la amenaza al Vigil.

programme.title: Montalbano
programme.desc: Montalbano sospecha que la muerte de un pescador y un ciego pueden estar relacionadas cuando sus cuentas bancarias revelan fortunas ocultas.

programme.title: Magnífica presencia
programme.desc: Un actor (Elio Germano) principiante descubre que su departamento nuevo y espacioso es completado con ocho fantasmas amistosos.

programme.title: El gran terremoto
programme.desc: Un geólogo lucha contra el tiempo para salvar a su esposa y dos hijos, de quienes está separado, cuando se produce un devastador terremoto en Oslo, Noruega.

programme.title: El valle oscuro
programme.desc: Austria, siglo XIX, una guerra surge entre un viajero y una familia local después de que uno de sus miembros muere bajo circunstancias misteriosas.

programme.title: El vendedor de tabaco
programme.desc: Durante los años 30, en Viena, un adolescente de 17 años se hace amigo de Sigmund Freud, uno de sus clientes asiduos durante la era nazi.

programme.title: Te amo solo a ti
programme.desc: Ninella tiene cincuenta años y un gran amor, don Mimì, con quien no se pudo casar. El destino le hace un regalo inesperado: su hija decide casarse con Damiano, el hijo del hombre con el que siempre soñó.

programme.title: Los bastardos de Pizzofalcone
programme.desc: Un niño fue secuestrado mientras visitaba un museo en Nápoles. Los Bastardos se deben enfrentar a una escalofriante historia de secuestro y chantaje.

programme.title: Montalbano
programme.desc: Montalbano sospecha que la muerte de un pescador y un ciego pueden estar relacionadas cuando sus cuentas bancarias revelan fortunas ocultas.

programme.title: Los crímenes de Oxford
programme.desc: Un estudiante (Elijah Wood) graduado y un profesor (John Hurt) intenta dejar de lado sus diferencias filosóficas para resolver el aparente asesinato de una anciana.

programme.title: Los caballeros
programme.desc: Mickey Pearson, un estadounidense expatriado en Londres, se ha hecho rico con el negocio de la marihuana. Sin embargo, cuando se difunde el rumor de que va a vender su imperio, varios criminales se disputan la oportunidad que se les presenta.

programme.title: A su lado
programme.desc: Después de un encuentro regado en alcohol, dos jugadores de un club de rugby en decadencia empiezan una relación amorosa, pero necesitan ocultárselo a sus compañeros de equipo para luchar por la victoria.

programme.title: Anhelo que me veas
programme.desc: La empleada de una galería de arte sigue a una joven que sospecha que es la niña que dio en adopción muchos años atrás.

programme.title: Vigil
programme.desc: Amy está atrapada y se le acaba el tiempo. En tierra, Kirsten persigue al cómplice del traidor. Cuando el traidor del Vigil pone en marcha sus planes, la tripulación se ve obligada a luchar para salvar la vida.

programme.title: Un verano inesperado
programme.desc: Una pareja gay de San Francisco acoge en su hogar a dos adolescentes italianos que acaban de llegar a los Estados Unidos con la intención de quedarse en el país. Poco a poco, entre los cuatro irá forjándose una amistad.

programme.title: El vendedor de tabaco
programme.desc: Durante los años 30, en Viena, un adolescente de 17 años se hace amigo de Sigmund Freud, uno de sus clientes asiduos durante la era nazi.

programme.title: Te amo solo a ti
programme.desc: Ninella tiene cincuenta años y un gran amor, don Mimì, con quien no se pudo casar. El destino le hace un regalo inesperado: su hija decide casarse con Damiano, el hijo del hombre con el que siempre soñó.

programme.title: Rocco Schiavone
programme.desc: El inspector Rocco Schiavone odia todo lo relacionado con la estación de montaña de Aosta: el frío, las montañas, la lejanía y, sobre todo, la nieve. Desafortunadamente para él, su primer caso se desarrrolla en ese ámbito.

programme.title: Rocco Schiavone
programme.desc: Hallan el cadáver ahorcado de una mujer en su propia casa. Rocco Schiavone deberá develar el misterio que se esconde tras este caso, vinculado a una red de hipocresía.

programme.title: Rocco Schiavone

programme.desc: Un viaje a través de seis continentes para conocer a músicos aficionados que han situado a Bach en el centro de su vida. Todos asisten a la mayor reunión mundial sobre Bach: el festival "Bach We Are Family", en Leipzig, Alemania, en 2022.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: El cadáver de una joven aparece en las orillas del río Tyne y Vera se enfrenta a una red de intrigas, traiciones y promesas perdidas.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: After being fired from her job as a bank teller, Frankie (Vivica A. Fox) begins working at a janitorial service with her friends Tisean (Kimberly Elise), a single mother; Cleo (Queen Latifah), a boisterous lesbian; and Stony (Jada Pinkett), who is dealing with the recent death of her brother. The women are struggling with their finances, so they decide to start robbing banks. At first the group is successful, but they soon attract the attention of an obsessive detective (John C. McGinley).

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

programme.title: New Jack City
programme.desc: Drug tycoon Nino Brown (Wesley Snipes) and his minions, known collectively as the Cash Money Brothers, have rapidly risen to the top of the New York City narcotics trade. Under Nino's heartless leadership, the drug operation has grown into a multimillion-dollar empire. Scotty (Ice-T) and Nick (Judd Nelson), two police officers who know their way around the streets of Harlem, aim to bring Nino and his cohorts down. To do so, though, they'll have to play by Nino's rules and go undercover.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou.

programme.title: Asylum
programme.desc: An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: In an ordinary suburban house, on a lovely tree-lined street, in the middle of 1970s America, lived the five beautiful, dreamy Lisbon sisters, whose doomed fates indelibly marked the neighborhood boys who to this day continue to obsess over them. A story of love and repression, fantasy and terror, sex and death, memory and longing. It is at its core a mystery story: a heart-rending investigation into the impenetrable, life-altering secrets of American adolescence.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon (Robert De Niro) who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side-effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: In the midst of the Great Depression, a businessman (Jeff Bridges) coping with the tragic death of his son, a jockey with a history of brutal injuries (Tobey Maguire) and a down-and-out horse trainer (Chris Cooper) team up to help Seabiscuit, a temperamental, undersized racehorse. At first the horse struggles to win, but eventually Seabiscuit becomes one of the most successful thoroughbreds of all time, and inspires a nation at a time when it needs it most.

programme.title: Kiss the Girls
programme.desc: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon (Robert De Niro) who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side-effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Vincent Vega (John Travolta) and Jules Winnfield (Samuel L. Jackson) are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace (Ving Rhames) ; his actress wife, Mia (Uma Thurman) ; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge (Bruce Willis) ; master fixer Winston Wolfe (Harvey Keitel) and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin (Tim Roth) and Honey Bunny (Amanda Plummer).

programme.title: Angel Heart
programme.desc: Harry Angel (Mickey Rourke) is a private detective contracted by Louis Cyphre (Robert De Niro) to track down the iconic singer Johnny Favorite. However, everybody that Angel questions about Favorite seems to meet a tragic demise. Eventually the trail leads Angel to New Orleans where he learns that Favorite had dabbled in the black arts. As Favorite's whereabouts and true identity become clear, Angel learns that being hired by Cyphre was not a random choice.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

programme.title: The Grifters
programme.desc: Hard-as-nails Lily Dillon (Anjelica Huston) works as a swindler for dangerous bookie Bobo (Pat Hingle), probably the only man she fears. Arriving in Los Angeles on business, Lily looks up her son, Roy (John Cusack), a small-time con artist content with paltry sleight-of-hand cheats. Roy's girlfriend, Myra (Annette Bening), looks like an All-American type but is a grifter looking to pull off another big-time con. The convergence of the three hustlers inevitably means trouble for all of them.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: In this satirical take on Westerns, crafty railroad worker Bart (Cleavon Little) becomes the first black sheriff of Rock Ridge, a frontier town about to be destroyed in order to make way for a new railroad. Initially, the people of Rock Ridge harbor a racial bias toward their new leader. However, they warm to him after realizing that Bart and his perpetually drunk gunfighter friend (Gene Wilder) are the only defense against a wave of thugs sent to rid the town of its population.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Carl Lee Hailey (Samuel L. Jackson) is a heartbroken black father who avenges his daughter's brutal rape by shooting the bigoted men responsible for the crime as they are on their way to trial. He turns to Jake Brigance (Matthew McConaughey), an untested lawyer, to defend him. Brigance struggles to believe that he can get Hailey acquitted in this small, segregated Southern town, given Hailey's race and the deliberate nature of his crimes, but Carl has unshakable faith in him.

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold (Jason Bateman) seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie (Kristen Wiig). Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy (Mila Kunis), an employee. But what Joel doesn't know is that Cindy is a sociopathic con artist, and a freak workplace accident clears the way for her to ruin Joel forever.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Kevin (Lance Bass) has everything going for him, but his lifelong lack of confidence keeps him from recognizing love and happiness -- even if it's sitting next to him. When Kevin meets the girl of his dreams, Abbey, on Chicago's L train, they connect immediately but he lets this golden opportunity slip away by not having the courage to ask her for her name and number. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji (Michael Wincott) commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

programme.title: The Parallax View
programme.desc: After a presidential candidate is assassinated, political reporter Joe Frady (Warren Beatty) begins to suspect that the mysterious Parallax Corporation may be involved. As he investigates, others who share his suspicions start turning up dead, including his editor, Bill Rintels (Hume Cronyn). Eventually, Frady uncovers a conspiracy bigger than anyone expected and must race to prevent the corporation's next big hit as this political thriller plays out in an explosive game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: Having concluded a case, detective Hercule Poirot (Albert Finney) settles into what he expects will be a relaxing journey home aboard the Orient Express. But when an unpopular billionaire is murdered en route, Poirot takes up the case, and everyone on board the famous train is a suspect. Using an avalanche blocking the tracks to his advantage, Poirot gradually realizes that many of the passengers have revenge as a motive, and he begins to home in on the culprit.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians, former showgirl Rachel Phelps (Margaret Whitton), has a sweetheart deal to move the team to Miami. But to break the lease with the city of Cleveland, ticket sales have to plummet. So Phelps hires the most incompetent players available, including near-blind pitcher Rick Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) and injury-prone catcher Jake Taylor (Tom Berenger). But her villainous tactics accidentally foster a can-do team spirit, turning the Indians into potential winners.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexi Vostrikov (Harrison Ford) who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius (Sean Connery) as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan (Alec Baldwin) sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Based on Tom Clancy's novel, this espionage thriller tracks a sinister plot to draw the United States and Russia into World War III. When the Russian president (Ciarán Hinds) suddenly dies, world tension escalates. Coupled with missing nuclear scientists and the threat of a nuclear detonation on United States soil, young CIA analyst Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) must uncover who is behind the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange (Benedict Cumberbatch) and a colleague, Daniel Domscheit-Berg (Daniel Brühl), join forces to become watchdogs over actions of the privileged and powerful. Despite scant resources, they are able to create a platform for whistle-blowers to leak covert data anonymously, thereby exposing government secrets and corporate crimes. However, a major battle erupts when Assange and Berg gain access to the biggest cache of confidential intelligence documents in U.S. history.

programme.title: Labor Day
programme.desc: At the tender age of 13, Henry Wheeler (Gattlin Griffith) grapples with the pains of adolescence while caring for his troubled, reclusive mother, Adele (Kate Winslet). One day while shopping for school supplies, Henry and Adele encounter Frank Chambers (Josh Brolin), an intimidating man but one who clearly needs their help. Frank convinces the two of them to take him into their home, but later it becomes clear that he is a convict who has escaped. Based on the novel by Joyce Maynard.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: In this lively animated adventure, undersea oddball SpongeBob SquarePants and his starfish friend, Patrick, embark on a quest to clear the name of Mr. Krabs, the owner of the Krusty Krab restaurant, who has been framed for stealing the crown of ocean deity King Neptune. Leaving the familiar confines of Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob and Patrick venture out towards Shell City, where they hope to find Neptune's crown, but numerous obstacles stand (or float) in their way.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: In this satirical take on Westerns, crafty railroad worker Bart (Cleavon Little) becomes the first black sheriff of Rock Ridge, a frontier town about to be destroyed in order to make way for a new railroad. Initially, the people of Rock Ridge harbor a racial bias toward their new leader. However, they warm to him after realizing that Bart and his perpetually drunk gunfighter friend (Gene Wilder) are the only defense against a wave of thugs sent to rid the town of its population.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down.

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

programme.title: The Great Food Truck Race
programme.desc: Tyler Florence leads the trucks to Virginia Beach, Va, where one team's past catches up to them; the strongest competitors conspire against each other, one of them to great success; another team struggles to prove they have what it takes to win.

programme.title: The Great Food Truck Race
programme.desc: The final three trucks undergo Tyler Florence's secret surveillance challenge in Newport News, VA, and the loser gets shut down for an hour. Then, the top teams blow challenges they could have easily won, and one truck sets an all-time sales record.

programme.desc: A Puerto Rican spot in San Antonio builds a unique take on nachos and cooks a monster chop; a gangster grill in New Orleans serves pork knuckles and sweet bird; a funky joint that makes pork tacos and puts collards in a mouthwatering melt.

programme.desc: A Southwest-Middle Eastern quick stop slinging the shawarma and salmon souvlaki in Santa Fe; a funky joint serving up outrageous Scandinavian specialties in Kansas City; in El Paso, a tortilla factory turning out top-notch tamales and tostadas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri and his son, Hunter, are taking a culinary journey up to Juneau, Alaska, and they dive into everything from a family-run, wood-fired pizza wagon making reindeer pie to a funky basement spot mashing up Latin-Asian fusion.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy goes from incredible Italian to sensational seafood; wood-fired pizza; crab cake cioppino and crab-spinach risotto; Vanilla Ice at a pirate-inspired joint serving up Brazilian and Caribbean seafood specialties.

programme.desc: Guy Fieri digs into dishes perfect for pickin' up and chowin' down, like a bomb barbecue pie at a pizza-bakery in Laramie, Wyo.; a funky Cleveland bar makes monster tots; a Vietnamese spot in Anchorage, Alaska, cooks up crepes.

programme.desc: Guy Fieri heads east to get a taste of the South; a smokehouse in New Hampshire is putting its own spin on meatloaf; a funky North Carolina joint is spicin' up its shrimp; a historic Florida spot is making a standout seafood stew.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Quando o corpo de uma jovem mulher é encontrado em Central Park, drenado de sangue e sem parte da orelha, os CSIs iniciam de imediato uma investigação que os leva à subcultura negra e misteriosa do vampirismo. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Crimes No Pacífico
programme.desc: O corpo mutilado de Ethan, um surfista de 22 anos, é encontrado no mar. Porém, a autópsia revela que ele foi atacado e morto não por um tubarão, mas por um cão de grande porte. A investigação também descobre que Ethan, apesar de ser um estudante brilhante, se prostituía. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Crimes No Pacífico
programme.desc: Depois de terem identificado o cão “assassino”, os investigadores descobrem que era a própria vítima que estava a tomar conta do animal na noite em que o pior aconteceu. De seguida, examinam a lista de clientes de Ethan e concentram-se num casal libertino com quem a vítima se encontrava frequentemente. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Os Mistérios De Brokenwood
programme.desc: Um grupo de membros de longa data do Brokenwood Golf Club reuniu-se para a jogada habitual de quarta-feira de manhã. Aproximavam-se do primeiro campo de golfe quando uma figura semelhante a um zombie aparece da alvorada e se dirige a eles. O grupo leva algum tempo a perceber que se trata, na verdade, de Adele Stone, a proprietária do Clube. Quando chegam perto dela, Ms. Stone estava já sem vida. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown vê-se envolvido com o MI5, o que coloca Lady Felicia numa posição comprometedora. Será ela capaz de trair o amigo para manter segredos do passado? Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Após a nova noiva de Sir Raleigh insistir em ver a sua múmia egípcia, o seu cadáver é descoberto numa sala fechada. Father Brown investiga - terá Amenhotep ressuscitado dos mortos? Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: O circo traz a morte a Kembleford quando um palhaço é assassinado. Father Brown tem de descobrir quem é o homicida e porque é que uma paroquiana aceitou casar com o feiticeiro sinistro, Welkin. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Um homicídio no quartel do exército local tendo como arma do crime uma espada partida leva Father Brown a investigar outra morte em Dunquerque há 13 anos atrás. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Quando o novo capitão da equipa de cricket de Kembleford é injustamente acusado de homicídio, Brown tem de provar a sua inocência para dar à equipa possibilidades de vencer a aldeia vizinha, Hambleston. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown testemunha o aparente suicídio de um aluno problemático do Upcott Seminary. Convicto de que se trata de um homicídio, ele convence Sid a ir em missão secreta para descobrir o homicida. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Quando o pai de um jovem escritor é encontrado morto, crescem anticorpos relativamente aos viajantes em Kembleford. Father Brown tem de descobrir a verdade antes que um deles seja mandado para a forca. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown e os amigos vêem-se presos com um grupo de hedonistas. Não demora muito até ficarem desesperados por escapar, já que no Hotel Cuba, a morte é prato do dia. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Quando um corpo é descoberto numa vinha, Father Brown tem de procurar o homicida entre um grupo de suspeitos bastante inventivos. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown envolve-se num audacioso roubo de arte planeado pelo seu adversário, Flambeau, que pretende usar o padre e seus amigos para um ajuste de contas. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom e a equipa são chamados após o apostador Tony Braun, também conhecido toxicodependente, ser encontrado morto, por um jardineiro, na sua casa. Uma vez que é descoberta uma parafernália de drogas ao pé do seu corpo e é determinado que ele inalou heroína recentemente, a causa da morte à primeira vista é overdose. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Toda a equipa CSI investiga um desaparecimento numa universidade local. Uma jovem desapareceu, aparentemente, da face da terra. Dados forenses levam-nos a possíveis suspeitos e todos os suspeitos têm motivos prováveis, mas nada parece bater certo. Isto leva a equipa a discutir a 'Teoria do Caos'. Quando combinados, vários eventos inofensivos poderão ter um final mortal. E o desfecho nem sempre está ao alcance. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom investiga um possível suicídio num local de construção famoso. Contra a vontade do Xerife, Grissom tenta chegar à verdade pois pensa que o suicídio foi na realidade um homicídio e usa teorias sobre electrocussão para encontrar o assassino. Entretanto, Nick e Catherine estão num caso com pouco mais do que filamentos de angorá para seguir. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Quando o palhaço da turma numa secundária local é encontrado morto, a equipa CSI é chamada para investigar o aluno, que é também o atleta de topo do campus, e que foi baleado nas costas na casa de banho. A equipa CSI rapidamente descobre que a vítima também era o bully da turma e Grissom está convencido que procura um colega de turma que foi finalmente levado ao limite. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom, Sara e Warrick são chamados para investigar um apartamento abandonado e com salpicos de sangue e Nick e Catherine têm que examinar um mergulhador morto preso numa árvore. Os membros da equipa ficam desconfiados quando um antigo inquilino do apartamento diz que a sua namorada desaparecida está de visita aos seus pais e os pais dizem que ela nunca apareceu. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: A CSI investiga o homicídio de um dançarino de rua competitivo, o que leva a equipa a um homicida improvável que tem um motivo chocante. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Quando o executivo de uma equipa de software sangra até à morte numa rua de Manhattan, para encontrar o homicida os CSIs têm de entrar no mundo molhado e confuso das festas onde grupos de pessoas experienciam comida de uma forma sensual. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Um grande acidente resulta na descoberta de uma rede interestadual de camiões especializados em carga humana e na colheita de órgãos para o mercado negro, o que desencadeia uma corrida contra o tempo para salvar um refém. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Após um corpo cair da Ponte do Queensboro, a equipa CSI encontra uma bússola perto do corpo que aponta para este, percebendo assim que se trata da terceira vítima do Assassino da Bússola. Entretanto, o detective Flack, ainda a lidar com a morte de Angell, abandona o serviço. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Mac e a equipa perdem o rasto do Assassino da Bússola no local da Exposição Mundial e rapidamente descobrem através da Astronomia e do nascer do sol que é uma questão de tempo até ele perseguir a próxima vítima. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: São encontrados restos mortais mumificados numa penthouse em Manhattan fechada há mais de 80 anos e Mac e Stella correm contra o tempo para encontrar as pessoas que descobriram o corpo e que ainda estão fechadas no edifício. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: A CSI descobre um esquema para lucrar milhões de dólares em seguros de vida quando um homem sem-abrigo reformado é encontrado morto num beco. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Um julgamento por homicídio é adiado e o suspeito é libertado sob fiança quando Stella descobre que o Procurador Distrital que trabalhava no caso adulterou a cena do crime para benefício pessoal. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Vera investiga a morte da pensionista Margaret Kraszewski, que foi esfaqueada num comboio, durante a hora de ponta. O caso acaba por ter um enorme impacto na vida pessoal de Joe, pois a sua filha é uma das testemunhas principais. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Vera desvenda um mistério de 30 anos após um assassinato brutal nas areias de um resort à beira-mar. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Um visitante da Letônia leva Charles e Jake a investigar a família de Nikolaj. Holt e Amy trazem o famoso cientista forense Dr. Yee para ajudar a encerrar o caso de Rosa. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: Um octogenário abastado morre poucos meses após ter casado com uma jovem stripper. Quando a sua viúva morre pouco tempo depois de overdose, as atenções voltam-se para o mordomo como potencial suspeito. No entanto, Brenda, que continua a ter dificuldade em ser aceite pelos seus colegas, tem os olhos postos nos três filhos adultos do falecido. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: Brenda e a sua equipa são encarregues de investigar o homicídio de um homem de negócios iraniano e do seu motorista no parque de estacionamento de um centro médico. Surgem complicações entre o Departamento de Polícia de Los Angeles e o FBI em relação à jurisdição do caso, uma vez que o nome do empresário consta na lista de suspeitos de terrorismo do FBI. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: Quando o corpo de uma vítima de homicídio vai parar à morgue, uma investigação de homicídio mal sucedida de há três anos atrás precisa de ser retomada por Brenda e a sua equipa, dando início a uma corrida contra o tempo para manter o verdadeiro assassino, que tem uma predileção por queimar mulheres vivas, atrás das grades com segurança. Entretanto, Taylor continua o seu ataque político à posição de Brenda. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: O conflito entre Brenda e Taylor chega a um ponto de rutura quando Brenda é acusada de conduta imprópria. Entretanto, a equipa de Brenda tem de investigar o homicídio de um produtor de Hollywood mediático. Os indícios apontam para que o homicídio tenha sido cometido por alguém da família da vítima. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: Brenda investiga o homicídio de um agente do Departamento de Polícia de Los Angeles enquanto se encontrava fora do seu local de trabalho, e Fritz pressiona-a a tomar uma decisão. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: Quando um jurado morre durante o julgamento de um chefe da máfia, Brenda tem de se desenrascar para interrogar os restantes membro dos júri. Entretanto, uma visita inesperada faz com que ela tenha de suspender os seus planos com Fritz. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: O homicídio de dois estudantes da USC, aparentemente num tiroteio de gangues, deixa outro estudante no hospital e Brenda a tentar conciliar os cuidados à mãe com a resolução do caso. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: The Closer
programme.desc: A investigação do homicídio do gerente de um restaurante da moda complica-se devido ao comportamento estranho de Brenda. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom e a sua equipa investigam um suspeito de homicídio que foi apanhado com a mão na massa - a enterrar as vítimas - enquanto Catherine e Warrick estão num caso de uma mulher encontrada morta no spa de um hotel. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom e Nick investigam a morte de um restaurador de livros enquanto Catherine e Sara são chamadas para a cena de um acidente fatal de comboio. Quando uma restauradora de livros é encontrada morta dentro de uma 'jaula', um local de trabalho de temperatura controlada, Grissom e Nick tentam determinar se foi um caso de suicídio ou homicídio. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom e Catherine investigam a morte aparentemente violenta de uma mulher encontrada numa caixa de areia. A investigação leva-os ao submundo de clubes S&M. Entretanto, Warrick e Sara são chamados a uma cena do crime para investigar um tiroteio, que inicialmente aparenta ter ocorrido durante um assalto. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom e a sua equipa investigam um assalto a um casino durante o qual vítimas inocentes foram alvejadas, enquanto Catherine e Sara são chamadas para a cena de um assassinato numa parte remota do deserto. As provas encontradas em cada cena do crime - o casino a abarrotar e a loja de conveniência isolada no deserto cujo dono foi assassinado - fazem com que a equipa CSI comece a tentar relacionar os dois crimes. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Com Grissom ausente, Warrick está no comando pela primeira vez enquanto a equipa investiga um assassinato de um aldrabão, que estava em fuga com algum dinheiro de turistas e que foi baleado e morto num parque de estacionamento. O suspeito principal revela ser a filha do Capitão Brass, o que leva Brass a retirar-se do caso profissionalmente, mas não pessoalmente. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: A equipa tenta perceber quem adulterou um carro de corridas para que se incendiasse e o seu condutor ficasse em estado grave. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: A equipa tem de reconstituir uma série de acontecimentos de uma noite de loucura de um grupo de amigos, que acabou com quatro cadáveres e uma quinta pessoa a vaguear pelas ruas coberta de sangue e munida de um machado. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: A equipa descobre que um duplo homicídio está ligado a uma investigação de dois bloggers jornalistas sobre fraude numa empresa que produz barras de ouro. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Sid determina que a morte de uma mulher cujo irmão gémeo desapareceu há 15 anos se tratou de um suicídio, mas Stella está convencida que ele está errado e decide prová-lo. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: O Dr. Hawkes fica preso num bloco de celas durante uma brecha de segurança orquestrada por uma cara familiar do passado da CSI. A única pessoa que o pode ajudar a ficar em segurança é o recluso do corredor da morte que matou a sua irmã. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: A equipa descobre uma liga de luta ilegal quando o corpo de um lutador de box reformado é encontrado enterrado em cimento num estaleiro. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Um adolescente fica gravemente ferido após ser alvejado num beco. O irmão mais novo da vítima presenciou o crime, mas não consegue dar uma descrição exata do incidente e do atirador à polícia. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: CSI: Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Um homicídio está relacionado com comportamentos suspeitos que Mac detectou no seu apartamento enquanto recuperava de uma lesão e a sua ex-namorada, Peyton Driscoll, pode estar ligada ao caso. Classificação etária: M/12.

Fox) is thrown back into the '50s when an experiment by his eccentric scientist friend Doc Brown (Christopher Lloyd) goes awry. Traveling through time in a modified DeLorean car, Marty encounters young versions of his parents (Crispin Glover, Lea Thompson), and must make sure that they fall in love or he'll cease to exist. Even more dauntingly, Marty has to return to his own time and save the life of Doc Brown.

programme.title: Night at the Museum
programme.desc: A night watchman (Ben Stiller) at a museum of natural history makes a startling discovery: Thanks to the unleashing of an ancient Egyptian curse, the museum's animals, birds, bugs and other exhibits spring to life after the building closes, and former President Teddy Roosevelt (Robin Williams) is among those the hapless guard encounters.

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: In this Disney animated tale, the orphaned Tarzan (Tony Goldwyn) grows up in the remote African wilderness, raised by the gentle gorilla Kala (Glenn Close). When a British expedition enters the jungle, Tarzan encounters the beautiful Jane (Minnie Driver) and recognizes that, like her, he's human. Falling in love with Jane, Tarzan is torn between embracing civilization and staying with his gorilla family, which becomes threatened by the ruthless hunter Clayton (Brian Blessed).

programme.title: Zootopia
programme.desc: From the largest elephant to the smallest shrew, the city of Zootopia is a mammal metropolis where various animals live and thrive. When Judy Hopps (Ginnifer Goodwin) becomes the first rabbit to join the police force, she quickly learns how tough it is to enforce the law. Determined to prove herself, Judy jumps at the opportunity to solve a mysterious case. Unfortunately, that means working with Nick Wilde (Jason Bateman), a wily fox who makes her job even harder.

programme.title: Coco
programme.desc: Despite his family's generations-old ban on music, young Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead. After meeting a charming trickster named Héctor, the two new friends embark on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: Carl Fredricksen (Ed Asner), a 78-year-old balloon salesman, is about to fulfill a lifelong dream. Tying thousands of balloons to his house, he flies away to the South American wilderness. But curmudgeonly Carl's worst nightmare comes true when he discovers a little boy named Russell is a stowaway aboard the balloon-powered house.

programme.title: Oliver & Company
programme.desc: In this animated update of the classic Oliver Twist tale, Oliver (Joey Lawrence) is an orphaned kitten taken in by a gang of thieving dogs, led by cavalier canine Dodger (Billy Joel) and owned by down-and-out pickpocket Fagin (Dom DeLuise). While pulling a job in the streets of New York City, Oliver winds up being adopted by a rich girl, Jenny (Natalie Gregory), and landing on easy street. But through a series of events, a loan shark threatens the peaceful new arrangement.

programme.title: Lady and the Tramp
programme.desc: This Disney animated classic follows a pampered cocker spaniel named Lady (Barbara Luddy) whose comfortable life slips away once her owners have a baby. When, after some tense circumstances, Lady finds herself on the loose and out on the street, she is befriended and protected by the tough stray mutt Tramp (Larry Roberts). A romance begins to blossom between the two dogs, but their many differences, along with more drama at Lady's household, threaten to keep them apart.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: Shy San Francisco teenager Mia Thermopolis (Anne Hathaway) is thrown for a loop when, from out of the blue, she learns the astonishing news that she's a real-life princess! As the heir apparent to the crown of the small European principality of Genovia, Mia begins a comical journey toward the throne when her strict and formidable grandmother, Queen Clarisse Renaldi (Julie Andrews), shows up to give her "princess lessons."

programme.title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
programme.desc: Mia (Anne Hathaway), still coming to terms with her life as a princess, graduates from Princeton. She returns to Genovia, and her best friend, Lilly (Heather Matarazzo), goes with her. When they arrive, Mia's grandmother (Julie Andrews) informs her that Mia cannot become queen unless she is married within 30 days. Nicholas Devereaux (Chris Pine) is one of her top suitors, though he is more interested in the crown than Mia. But when Nicholas realizes he loves Mia, he decides not to pursue her.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: Fearful that her ailing father will be drafted into the Chinese military, Mulan (Ming-Na Wen) takes his spot -- though, as a girl living under a patriarchal regime, she is technically unqualified to serve. She cleverly impersonates a man and goes off to train with fellow recruits. Accompanied by her dragon, Mushu (Eddie Murphy), she uses her smarts to help ward off a Hun invasion, falling in love with a dashing captain along the way.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: When street rat Aladdin frees a genie from a lamp, he finds his wishes granted. However, he soon finds that the evil has other plans for the lamp -- and for Princess Jasmine. But can Aladdin save Princess Jasmine and his love for her after she sees that he isn't quite what he appears to be?

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: An arrogant young prince and his castle's servants fall under the spell of a wicked enchantress, who turns him into the hideous Beast until he learns to love and be loved in return. The spirited, headstrong village girl Belle enters the Beast's castle after he imprisons her father Maurice. With the help of his enchanted servants, including the matronly Mrs. Potts, Belle begins to draw the cold-hearted Beast out of his isolation.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In Disney's beguiling animated romp, rebellious 16-year-old mermaid Ariel (Jodi Benson) is fascinated with life on land. On one of her visits to the surface, which are forbidden by her controlling father, King Triton, she falls for a human prince. Determined to be with her new love, Ariel makes a dangerous deal with the sea witch Ursula (Pat Carroll) to become human for three days. But when plans go awry for the star-crossed lovers, the king must make the ultimate sacrifice for his daughter.

programme.title: The Lion King
programme.desc: This Disney animated feature follows the adventures of the young lion Simba (Jonathan Taylor Thomas), the heir of his father, Mufasa (James Earl Jones). Simba's wicked uncle, Scar (Jeremy Irons), plots to usurp Mufasa's throne by luring father and son into a stampede of wildebeests. But Simba escapes, and only Mufasa is killed. Simba returns as an adult (Matthew Broderick) to take back his homeland from Scar with the help of his friends Timon (Nathan Lane) and Pumbaa (Ernie Sabella).

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: An animated Disney adventure follows disfigured Quasimodo (Tom Hulce), the bell-ringer of Notre Dame Cathedral, who bides his time locked away in a tower. With only gargoyles to keep him company, Quasimodo longs to be with other people, leading to his chance encounter with the enchanting Gypsy Esmeralda (Demi Moore). When the beautiful young woman catches the attention of Quasimodo's guardian, sinister Frollo (Tony Jay), Quasimodo must help to keep her out of his clutches.

programme.title: Spy x Family

programme.title: Spy x Family

programme.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest

programme.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest

programme.title: Wakfu
programme.desc: Amalia, Tristepin et Evangélyne se réveillent sur un îlot minuscule. Le bateau a été attaqué par une créature mythique, un Kralamoure Géant, et celui-ci a sombré dans les abysses. En fait d'îlot il s'agit d'une île immense et verdoyante protégée par un antique sort d'invisibilité. La mystérieuse île d'Oma, où se trouverait la vraie famille de Yugo.

programme.title: Wakfu
programme.desc: Pendant que Yugo explore Oma en compagnie d'Adamaï, ses amis découvrent les ruines d'un temple gardées par un terrifiant dragon.

programme.title: Wakfu
programme.desc: Après avoir acheté le bateau avec l'argent qu'ils ont gagné à Bonta, Yugo et ses amis se rendent enfin sur l'île d'Oma. Seulement, il semblerait qu'il y ait un passager clandestin à bord du navire, un passager aux intentions malveillantes.

programme.title: Wakfu
programme.desc: Au cours de leur voyage en mer, les cinq amis sont pris dans une terrible tempête et leur bateau est alors rejeté sur une île. Yugo, Amalia et Evangelyne débarquent à la recherche de nourriture, mais un peuple Sadida primitif les prend en otage.

programme.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
programme.desc: Natsu et ses amis affrontent les autres membres de la guilde. Ils tentent de leur faire perdre connaissance pour les libérer de l'emprise mentale du Mage blanc. Également hypnotisé, Jellal fait preuve d'un comportement inattendu face à Erza.

programme.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest

programme.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest

À 42 ans, il arrive à un tournant de sa vie : le poste de directeur lui est ouvertement proposé et sa compagne depuis un an, Hélène, a la ferme intention de l'épouser. Pour Dino, la vie est belle. Sauf que cette vie parfaite s'est construite sur un mensonge : Dino s'appelle en fait Mourad Ben Saoud.

programme.title: Mashle

programme.title: Mashle

programme.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
programme.desc: Skullion envoie un ordre de retrait à ses compagnons de Diabolos. Tandis que Kiria y obéit à contrecœur, Nebaru ne veut rien entendre, et emploie même la Force du Dragon en vue de dévorer Wendy.

programme.title: Moi, quand je me réincarne en Slime

programme.title: Moi, quand je me réincarne en Slime

programme.title: The Man in the Iron Mask
programme.desc: The former musketeer Athos (John Malkovich) swears vengeance after despotic King Louis XIV (Leonardo DiCaprio) causes the death of his son. Summoning his old comrades Porthos (Gérard Depardieu) and Aramis (Jeremy Irons), he hatches a plan to liberate a shackled prisoner rumored to be the king's twin brother, and then install him on the throne. But the three musketeers must also contend with their old friend D'Artagnan (Gabriel Byrne), who has remained in the king's service.

programme.title: Adventureland
