programme.desc: Saviez-vous que la guerre sous-marine a permis à votre repas de livraison d'arriver à bon port ? Hannah Fry explore l'histoire des applis de livraison comme Deliveroo et Just Eat.

programme.title: Chasse estivale du renard
programme.desc: Dès le mois de juin, comme le sanglier, le renard figure au tableau de la préouverture en raison des risques sanitaires que présente sa prolifération. Ce documentaire nous emmène sur les terres de prédilection du goupil, le piémont pyrénéen et le Gers. Là-bas, l'été se conjugue avec la traque de ce nuisible qui donne ses lettres de noblesse à la chasse.

programme.title: Les vertus de la Venaison
programme.desc: C'est à son fruit que l'on mesure la valeur d'un arbre.... C'est à la venaison qu'on reconnait celle de la chasse. Et si nous parlions de ce que produit l'acte de chasser ? La nourriture qu'il procure..., qui a fondé son existence. Ce documentaire rend les honneurs au fruit de la pratique cynégétique. Cinquante-deux minutes pour redonner sa raison à la venaison.

programme.title: Eric et Émeric, reflet en bout de ligne
programme.desc: Eric et son fils Emeric partagent une passion commune : la pêche de la carpe en compétition. De leur sympathique complicité à leurs stratégies de pêches, ce documentaire suit le binôme au fil de leur préparation hivernale et de leurs premières compétitions de la saison.

programme.title: Les gabionneurs du Sud
programme.desc: La chasse du gibier d'eau de nuit est souvent attribuée aux chasseurs du Nord de la France. Mais, même s'ils ne sont pas majoritaires, quelques chasseurs à l'accent chantant du Sud sont aussi passionnés et aguerris que leurs compères nordiques. Certains seraient même surpris à la lecture des carnets de prélèvement de ces gabions... installés ça et là, tout près de la Méditerranée. Leurs installations bénéficient de petits couloirs migratoires qui peuvent être exceptionnels... Sur les étangs héraultais, étapes quatre étoiles pour oiseaux migrateurs, ce documentaire fait vivre une saison de chasse en compagnie de Baptiste, Michel et leurs amis.

programme.title: Marais poitevin, la Venise verte des pêcheurs
programme.desc: Dans l'écrin halieutique de sa région natale, Gaëtan Raimbert se sent comme un poisson dans l'eau... Ce documentaire s'immerge avec lui dans la deuxième plus grande zone humide de France. Entouré de quatre voisins, notre champion arpente son domaine et la gamme de poissons, carnassiers et anguilles qu'il offre. Aussi variée que le nombre de ses canaux. Supplément de cette abondance maraîchine : les multiples modes de pêche, dont certains sont spécifiques.

programme.title: Peacock bass, prédateur amazonien
programme.desc: Imaginez un poisson d'aquarium aux couleurs éclatantes et d'une puissance phénoménale, vivant dans l'immense bassin du plus grand fleuve au monde, l'Amazone ! Ce documentaire part à la découverte de ce fabuleux adversaire tropical, qu'on appelle : Peacock bass en anglais, ou bien Tucunaré dans les pays sud-américains. Immersion dans la forêt Brésilienne à la recherche de ces poissons d'exception en compagnie d'une équipe de pêcheurs aguerris et de guides locaux.

programme.title: Ramiro, moucheur tourangeau
programme.desc: Son lancer est incroyable ; précis et délicat, dans une cadence et une fluidité qui se rapprochent d'un ballet. Ramiro a l'élégance et le tempérament (argentins) qui domptent le moindre poisson. Rencontre avec ce champion sportif devenu moucheur depuis qu'il a découvert la Touraine, il y a trente ans. Cinquante-deux minutes en action sur tous les cours d'eau de sa région adoptive, dont il exalte l'abondance halieutique.

programme.title: Afrique du sud, la vraie sauvage
Pêche et ovalie, passions méditerranéennes
programme.desc: Coéquipiers depuis dix ans, Pierrick Nova et son ami Sébastien Giorgis, joueurs de rugby professionnels évoluant au Racing Club narbonnais, sont unis par le rugby et par une autre passion : la pêche en mer. C'est dans la grande famille du ballon ovale qu'ils ont rencontré Ivan Roux, ancien joueur de Toulon aujourd'hui à la tête de son propre restaurant de poissons, et Alan Brazo, célèbre troisième ligne de Perpignan, toujours en activité mais aussi docteur en océanographie. Dès leur première rencontre tout les a réunis, du ballon ovale au leurre souple, du denti en no kill au carpaccio de thon rouge.

programme.title: La chasse en corse, une evidence insulaire
programme.desc: En Corse, on naît chasseur ! Ou alors très souvent on le devient ... Dans chaque famille insulaire, on compte au moins un pratiquant. Ces traditions que l'on enseigne, la fraternité que l'on protège, sont des valeurs que l'on retrouvent d'un bout à l'autre de l'île de Beauté et que la chasse perpétue. Dans le Royaume maquisard, le sanglier règne et s'épanouit. Mais la Corse offre aussi de belles opportunités pour chasser les oiseaux migrateurs et réserve également des surprises, comme la chasse de la bécassine dans quelques secteurs de l'île jalousement gardés.

programme.title: Mequinenza, capitale européenne des pêcheurs
programme.desc: C'est la fin de la saison touristique, et le petit village de Méquinenza en Aragon fait encore exception cette année avec une forte affluence de pêcheurs venus de toute l'Europe pour se confronter aux nombreux carnassiers présents dans les eaux très riches du Rio Ebro. Il faut dire que très récemment, en ces lieux uniques, un nouveau record a été battu, celui du plus grand silure albinos pêché sur la planète, un spécimen de 2m53. Les guides de pêche locaux sont sur le qui-vive et usent de tous les stratagèmes pour satisfaire au mieux leurs clients, en quête eux aussi d'un record.

programme.title: Sauvaginiers du Mont, les gardiens de la baie
programme.desc: Les sauvaginiers du Mont Saint-Michel pratiquent parfois la chasse au trou, à la passée, ou encore au hutteau. Mais dans la baie, authentique paradis pour les chasseurs de gibier d'eau, c'est la chasse au gabion qui est reine ; une discipline nocturne, où le secret réside dans l'art de la pique des appelants pour la pose des canards sauvages. Passionnés par les anatidés et gestionnaires très impliqués dans la protection de leur merveille, les sauvaginiers du Mont sont les gardiens des traditions et de la baie.

programme.title: Ma campagne, mon art de vivre !
programme.desc: Un accent qui chante, le be'ret visse' sur la te^te, tanto^t une bêche ou un ra^teau a la main, tanto^t une canne a pe^che ou une carabine en bandoulie re, mais toujours le sourire aux le vres. Rencontre avec Benoit, qui fait rimer générosité et transmission des traditions. L'occasion de vivre à ses côtés le partage de parties de pêche à la truite entre amis, d'approche du chevreuil avec son fre re, ou de pe^che de la friture avec sa fille de 5 ans.

programme.title: Bijagos, mission pêche
programme.desc: Les Bijagos forment un archipel de quatre-vingt-huit îles au large de la Guinée-Bissau. Ces îles abritent une flore et une faune considérables. Seulement une dizaine d'îles sont habitées, les autres sont laissées à la forêt, aux singes et aux hippopotames de mer... Cette richesse se retrouve aussi en mer, avec de nombreuses espèces de poissons, dont les plus sportives et les plus prisées des passionnés de pêche ! Il y a notamment les Carangues dont on trouve au moins cinq espèces localement, les liches aux attaques spectaculaires, les très voraces carpes rouges, ainsi que les cobias, otolithes, barracudas. A la rencontre de pêcheurs passionnés.

programme.title: Pêcheurs de gouffres et de torrents
programme.desc: Des Alpes aux Pyrénées, en passant par la Corse et les Cévennes..., cinquante-deux minutes de pêche entre altitudes et abîmes..., aux extrémités de la pêche en eaux vives. Réservés aux cannes assez entraînées, ces sites se méritent. Certains pêcheurs de salmonidés, souvent amateurs de techniques fines et délicates, fuient les grandes rivières de plaine pour se consacrer aux petits cours d'eau de montagne, encaissés, abrupts et torrentueux à souhait. Ils succombent à l'attrait des obstacles que présente la pêche des torrents de montagne alpins, pyrénéens ou massif centraliens. Ce documentaire part à la rencontre de ces pêcheurs, galvanisés par les obstacles et la difficulté.

programme.title: Autriche, la Salza des moucheurs
programme.desc: Outre la beauté des lieux, la Salza possède un atout-maître : elle offre une très forte population de salmonidés et il est fréquent d'y prendre, en une dizaine de lancers, une arc-en-ciel, une fario et un ombre. Chaque pêcheur à la mouche est en quête du cours d'eau parfait et nos pêcheurs français pourraient bien l'avoir trouvé en Autriche.

programme.title: L'esprit d'equipe
programme.desc: David Banquet, ancien joueur de rugby professionnel aujourd'hui entraineur et passionné par la chasse aux gibiers d'eau depuis sa plus tendre enfance, assure qu'il existe beaucoup de similitudes entre le rugby et la chasse aux canards. Que ce soit dans la préparation, les choix, l'investissement, l'esprit d'équipe, rugby et chasse ne font qu'un. Le temps d'une saison, entre les terrains du Rugby Club du Bassin d'Arcachon et les marais du Médoc, David prouve que chasse à la tonne et l'ovalie se rapprochent bien plus qu'il n'y parait.

programme.title: Boat trip à Madagascar
programme.desc: Allons faire un tour dans les grands sites de pêche qui entourent Madagascar. Un bateau, le catamaran «Illusion» rejoint des endroits magiques où les pêcheurs passent en revue poissons et techniques diverses. Une aventure hors des sentiers battus sous forme de «boat movie» halieutique dont le principe, le rythme et la mise en images détonnent.

programme.title: À la mouche sur les flats du fleuve Saint-Laurent
programme.desc: Le fleuve Saint Laurent est mondialement connu pour ses populations de cétacés, mais beaucoup moins pour ses possibilités de pêche sportive. Ce secteur de l'estuaire fluvial offre d'immenses étendues d'eau douce, peu profondes, avec des zones herbeuses propices au développement de nombreuses espèces de poissons. Accompagnés par le spécialiste des lieux : Thomas Guyard, Sabrina et Ludovic vont profiter d'un programme très alléchant : dix jours de pêche sportive intense à la recherche d'espèces endémiques à certains fleuves canadiens.

programme.title: Passion brame
programme.desc: Le cerf, le plus grand ongulé de France, roi des forêts, vit à l'automne sa saison des amours. Il sort de la forêt, se fait moins discret pour le plus grand plaisir des amateurs de brame. Aux quatre coins de la France, des hommes et des femmes passionnés suivent cette période entre la mi-septembre et la mi-octobre. Ils arpentent les chemins, avancent dans les layons à la billebaude, d'autres se fabriquent des cachettes, certains investissent des miradors. Tout est bon pour entrer dans l'intimité des scènes de brame, sans déranger les animaux. Rencontre avec des passionnés.

programme.title: Les gabionneurs du Sud
programme.desc: La chasse du gibier d'eau de nuit est souvent attribuée aux chasseurs du Nord de la France. Mais, même s'ils ne sont pas majoritaires, quelques chasseurs à l'accent chantant du Sud sont aussi passionnés et aguerris que leurs compères nordiques. Certains seraient même surpris à la lecture des carnets de prélèvement de ces gabions... installés ça et là, tout près de la Méditerranée. Leurs installations bénéficient de petits couloirs migratoires qui peuvent être exceptionnels... Sur les étangs héraultais, étapes quatre étoiles pour oiseaux migrateurs, ce documentaire fait vivre une saison de chasse en compagnie de Baptiste, Michel et leurs amis.

programme.title: Petit gibier en Afrique du sud, le rêve africain
La 3ème symphonie halieutique de Samir
programme.desc: Nous connaissons déjà ce «petit génie», un artiste au 'pattern' légendaire. Surdoué de la canne à pêche, Samir Kerdjou force l'admiration à chacune de ses Au fil de ce documentaire, il se confie et accepte de partager les secrets de son savoir-faire. Cinquante-deux minutes dans les coulisses du maître, en témoins de sa communion avec le poisson.

programme.title: Là-haut dans les rocheuses
programme.desc: Sur les hauteurs des montagnes Rocheuses (Canada), on traque le cerf mulet et la chèvre des Rocheuses. Cette chasse sportive nous plonge dans une nature sanctuarisée avec un cumul exceptionnel de sensations. Ces gibiers offrent autant à ceux qui les convoitent qu'ils exigent d'eux pour les atteindre, c'est-à-dire beaucoup.

programme.title: Au coeur des marais, les tonnayres du Médoc
programme.desc: Plongeon au coeur de la tradition séculaire de la chasse à la tonne, une pratique unique dans les vastes marais du Médoc. Éric, de David et de leurs compères tonnayres partagent leur passion, dans l'ambiance des nuits d'hiver, aux guichets de leurs installations. Ils écoutent leurs appelants lancer l'alerte lors des passages de migrateurs, scrutent la pénombre en quête de pose d'oiseaux sauvages - souchets, sarcelles, pilets, siffleurs ou morillons... - venus du nord.

programme.title: Une histoire de famille
programme.desc: Une histoire de famille ; une histoire de tradition et d'héritage intergénérationnelle. Et surtout, une histoire de passion pour une chasse ancestrale et identitaire des Landes : la chasse à la palombe. David et Sébastien, frères gascons, font partager, le temps d'une journée, cette chasse à l'oiseau bleu qui anime leur région des Landes, d'octobre à novembre, dans la palombière au milieu des grands pins de la forêt de Giscos.

programme.title: Ramiro, moucheur tourangeau
programme.desc: Son lancer est incroyable ; précis et délicat, dans une cadence et une fluidité qui se rapprochent d'un ballet. Ramiro a l'élégance et le tempérament (argentins) qui domptent le moindre poisson. Rencontre avec ce champion sportif devenu moucheur depuis qu'il a découvert la Touraine, il y a trente ans. Cinquante-deux minutes en action sur tous les cours d'eau de sa région adoptive, dont il exalte l'abondance halieutique.

programme.title: Bécassiers des dunes
programme.desc: Au milieu des dunes atlantiques, ce documentaire de Thomas Bounoure explore ce territoire de chasse particulier où le sable dicte sa loi à ceux qi s'y aventurent : chasseur comme gibier... Une immersion dans un univers hors normes, entre chasse à la bécasse... et quelques escapades de pêche en mer, si proche.

programme.title: L'appel du large ou quand le loisir devient leur metier...
programme.desc: Pour eux, la pêche est l'occasion de prolonger le contact avec la mer, toujours présente au quotidien depuis leur enfance... Ils ont besoin de cette intimité permanente avec le large, de rester à portée d'embrun de la mer. Un jour, ils ont fait leur métier de passion de la pêche et de la mer. Ils sont devenus marins pêcheur et partagent une même vision de la durabilité : techniques de pêche dormantes, valorisation de toutes les espèces, pratiques limitant les rejets... Nous embarquons avec Benoît, Anthony, François, Tomy pour comprendre ce qui les a motivés à prendre le large.

programme.title: Actions de chasse en battue
programme.desc: L'action de chasse, c'est ce que cherchent à vivre tous les postés et les rabatteurs. Pour un rabatteur, c'est la rencontre de l'homme ou de son chien avec un animal. Pour le posté, l'action de chasse commence par du son, le bruit des chiens au loin. Puis l'arrivée des animaux qui se bloquent avant de jaillir au saut de l'allée et le choix de faire un acte de chasse ou pas. Ce documentaire suit les pas de postés et de rabatteurs sur trois territoires très giboyeux.

programme.title: Chasseur de traces
programme.desc: Dans l'art de la chasse, «Avant le gibier... il y a sa trace.» Qui sait la décoder prend un bon départ. L'habileté pour la dénicher constitue un atout majeur. Ce documentaire suit les pas de Jean-Louis Orengo, grand praticien de la quête d'indices, un véritable artiste de la lecture des sols, militant de la connaissance des empreintes, lien vital entre le chasseur et la faune.

programme.desc: C'est le procès de Cabe et l'équipe est inquiète de connaître le résultat. Ils concentrent leur énergie sur le sauvetage d'un chien coincé dans une citerne.

programme.title: Scorpion
programme.desc: Walter s'évanouit le soir de Noël et rêve d'un monde où l'équipe Scorpion n'a jamais existé. Walter doit rassembler l'équipe à nouveau.

programme.title: Scorpion
programme.desc: L'équipe Scorpion est embauchée pour l'inspection d'un bunker. Créé par une société spécialisée dans le logement post-apocalyptique, celui-ci est géré par une intelligence artificielle.

programme.title: Scorpion
programme.desc: Tandis que les membres de Scorpion vaquent à leurs occupations, une éruption solaire importante provoque une panne générale d'électricité à Los Angeles, qui entraîne elle-même une panique généralisée.

programme.title: Most Wanted Criminals
programme.desc: Un jeune homme tire accidentellement sur un policier pour se défendre et prend la fuite. L'équipe se trouve face à un dilemme moral quant à la meilleure façon de faire justice. Barnes et sa femme peinent avec leurs projets d'avoir un nouvel enfant.

programme.title: Most Wanted Criminals
programme.desc: L'équipe recherche deux frères décidés à se venger des membres d'une compagnie qui a causé des dommages environnementaux à leur ville. Sarah rencontre le reste de la famille LaCroix, dont la sœur de Jess, Louise.

programme.title: Most Wanted Criminals
programme.desc: L'équipe se rend à DC pour protéger l'ancienne indic d'Ortiz, menacée par un tueur à gage. Sarah aide la famille de Jess à se préparer pour le mariage de dernière minute de Byron et Marie.

programme.title: Most Wanted Criminals
programme.desc: Jess et l'équipe se rendent au Tennessee pour traquer un agent infiltré de la DEA qui est maintenant corrompu et lié à un réseau de trafic de drogue. Sarah se demande si elle n'a pas commis une erreur en emménageant si vite avec Jess et Tali.

programme.title: Le Transporteur - la série
programme.desc: Frank doit livrer un million d'euros dans le sud de la France en faisant la course avec deux autres coursiers d'élite. Le client dont le Transporteur aura gagné remportera un contrat juteux pour des missiles. Des gangs ont eu vent de cette course et vont tenter de dérober l'argent mais Frank, qui doit prouver qu'il est le seul et unique Transporteur valable sur le marché, ne compte pas se laisser flouer...

programme.title: Le Transporteur - la série
programme.desc: Frank est chargé de livrer une micropuce volée, destinée au développement d'armes perfectionnées. Le système de livraison ayant été truqué, s'il ne livre pas le colis dans un délai de douze heures, il sera tué. Frank s'engage dans une course contre la montre...

programme.title: Le Transporteur - la série
programme.desc: Pris en chasse par la police, Frank découvre rapidement que le colis qu'il a livré est en fait une puissante bombe destinée à des terroristes qui veulent frapper en plein coeur de Paris. Frank doit retrouver et arrêter au plus vite Gassam, le poseur de bombe prêt à tout pour venger son frère tué accidentellement lors d'un contrôle d'identité.

programme.title: Le Transporteur - la série
programme.desc: Un collectionneur d'art psychopathe engage Frank pour livrer un chef-d'oeuvre inestimable. Lorsqu'il s'avère que le tableau est un faux, l'homme accuse Frank d'avoir dérobé l'original. Dans sa quête de la vraie toile, Frank fait équipe avec une jeune femme qui revendique l'oeuvre d'art. Il fait aussi la connaissance de Lara, une femme aux tendances sadomasochistes, prête à tout pour obtenir ce qu'elle veut...

programme.title: Joséphine, ange gardien

programme.title: Joséphine, ange gardien

programme.title: Joséphine, ange gardien
programme.desc: Les trois enfants de Rémy ne se parlent plus et ne viennent presque plus le voir, à son grand désespoir. Pour réunir ses trois clients autour de leur père, Joséphine demande l'aide d'un autre ange. A sa grande surprise, c'est son double qui apparaît.

programme.title: Joséphine, ange gardien
programme.desc: Les trois enfants de Rémy ne se parlent plus et ne viennent presque plus le voir, à son grand désespoir. Pour réunir ses trois clients autour de leur père, Joséphine demande l'aide d'un autre ange. A sa grande surprise, c'est son double qui apparaît.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Un témoin clé et le marshal chargé de sa protection sont assassinés au cours d'une embuscade. Le programme de protection des témoins étant compromis, Maggie et OA vont enquêter afin de retrouver la personne responsable de la fuite d'information.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: L'agent Zidan se lance dans une opération sous couverture pour faire tomber Martin Vickers, avec l'aide de Maggie et Rowan Quinn. En prenant l'identité de l'informateur décédé, Otan Reiss, l'agent Zidan espère se rapprocher de sa cible.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Le FBI remonte au trafic de drogue opéré par le gang nigérian, les White Horses, suite à l'assassinat d'un diplomate américain. Jubal et OA aident d'anciennes connaissances à combattre leurs démons intérieurs.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Le général Ahmed El-Masri, haut dignitaire égyptien controversé, se rend à New York pour une transplantation cardiaque. Lorsque OA est affecté à sa protection directe, il est tiraillé entre son devoir et son opinion de l'homme.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: L'agent du FBI, Greg Kennedy, est assassiné. Les résultats de l'enquête sont troublants car l'homme menait une double vie. Maggie s'interroge sur ce qu'elle devrait dire à la veuve de l'agent.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Frank critique ouvertement la procureure Crawford lors d'une conférence de presse, ce qui déplait à Erin. Joe et Jamie enquêtent sur un trafic sexuel et finissent par faire équipe avec Danny et Baez qui poursuivent le même suspect.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Le chemin de Danny croise celui de Sonny Le, un criminel d'une précédente affaire, lorsqu'il enquête sur une attaque de gang avec un mobile choquant.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Les tensions sont hautes dans la famille Reagan lorsque Frank et son petit-fils Joe Hill font face à une grave insulte à la mémoire du père de Joe.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Jamie et sa nouvelle équipe de renseignements infiltrent un réseau high-tech de contrebande de voitures. Frank affronte le chef du transit de la ville à propos d'un nouveau programme de police qui cause des blessures aux agents sur le terrain.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: L'enquête de Danny et Baez sur la mort d'un escroc des échecs se complique. Erin se voit offrir l'appui d'un influent pasteur de Harlem pour sa campagne pour le poste de procureur général en échange d'une faveur professionnelle.

programme.title: Hunting : chasseurs de criminels
programme.desc: L'équipe est à la recherche de Brenda Lowe, une tueuse évadée de la fosse, obsédée par les loups. Le groupe retrouve sa trace dans une réserve sauvage du Montana, où un chasseur est retrouvé mort poignardé.

programme.title: Hunting : chasseurs de criminels
programme.desc: L'équipe se rend à Chicago sur la trace du Dr Ezekiel Malak, un psychiatre qui tuait des patients en soins intensifs. Bex, Shane et Jacob cherchent des liens possibles entre ses nouvelles victimes.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Le travail de serveuse de Charlie dans un dîner-théâtre est interrompu par une mort tragique sur scène au cours d'un spectacle donné par deux stars de la télévision. Lorsqu'elle commence à enquêter, des motivations mortelles apparaissent.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Dans le Tennessee, les deux pilotes de karting Keith Owens et Davis McDowell entretiennent une rivalité tenace. Lorsque Katy, la fille d'Owens, est victime d'un accident, Charlie tente de savoir qui aurait pu saboter le véhicule qu'elle conduisait...

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Charlie est engagée comme assistante par Arthur Liptin, qui a créé LAM, une entreprise qui gère les effets spéciaux. Il culpabilise énormément depuis le décès d'une actrice survenu sur le tournage d'un film.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Dans les montagnes du Colorado, alors que Charlie vient de prendre en stop Morty, elle emboutit sa voiture en voulant éviter un cerf. Sa passagère ne revenant pas avec du secours, Charlie tente de faire signe à un véhicule de s'arrêter.

programme.title: Brick Mansions
programme.desc: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice. Meanwhile, Damien and an ex-con named Lino (David Belle) work together to save the city from a plot to destroy it.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A veteran criminal planning a major bank robbery, Buck (Robert Patrick) assembles a team to pull off the heist. When the fugitive Luther (Duane Whitaker) travels to meet the crew in Mexico, he unexpectedly ends up near a bar in the middle of the desert and gets turned into a vampire by one of the establishment's fang-sporting regulars. Before long, Luther joins his fellow felons at the bank, but his newfound blood-sucking ways result in plenty of fierce human and vampire conflict.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: An executioner's daughter joins an outlaw, who escaped death, in a journey that leads to vampires.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians, former showgirl Rachel Phelps (Margaret Whitton), has a sweetheart deal to move the team to Miami. But to break the lease with the city of Cleveland, ticket sales have to plummet. So Phelps hires the most incompetent players available, including near-blind pitcher Rick Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) and injury-prone catcher Jake Taylor (Tom Berenger). But her villainous tactics accidentally foster a can-do team spirit, turning the Indians into potential winners.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A quiet man and his son take in a wounded stranger near his homestead, along with a bag full of cash. The stranger claims he's a sheriff being pursued by outlaws, but the man can't be sure.

programme.title: Approaching the Unknown
programme.desc: An American astronaut (Mark Strong) tests his will, sanity and endurance while embarking on a one-way, solo mission to Mars.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney.. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: CIA recruit Jack Ryan is caught in a dangerous web of intrigue and espionage spun between a shadowy government agent, his unsuspecting fiancée and a fearless Russian power broker. To stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States, Jack must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael is on his daily commute home, which quickly becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a mysterious stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a deadly plan is unfolding, and he is unwittingly caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit.

programme.title: The House With a Clock in Its Walls
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Lewis goes to live with his oddball uncle in a creaky old house that contains a mysterious ticktock noise. He soon learns that Uncle Jonathan and his feisty neighbor, Mrs. Zimmerman, are powerful practitioners of the magic arts. When Lewis accidentally awakens the dead, the town's sleepy facade suddenly springs to life -- revealing a secret and dangerous world of witches, warlocks and deadly curses.

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: As a group of New Yorkers (Michael Stahl-David, Mike Vogel, Odette Yustman) enjoy a going-away party, little do they know that they will soon face the most terrifying night of their lives. A creature the size of a skyscraper descends upon the city, leaving death and destruction in its wake. Using a handheld video camera, the friends record their struggle to survive as New York crumbles around them.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Astronauts (Jake Gyllenhaal, Rebecca Ferguson, Ryan Reynolds) aboard the International Space Station are on the cutting edge of one of the most important discoveries in human history: the first evidence of extraterrestrial life on Mars. As members of the crew conduct their research, the rapidly evolving life-form proves far more intelligent and terrifying than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jimmy Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: As a group of New Yorkers (Michael Stahl-David, Mike Vogel, Odette Yustman) enjoy a going-away party, little do they know that they will soon face the most terrifying night of their lives. A creature the size of a skyscraper descends upon the city, leaving death and destruction in its wake. Using a handheld video camera, the friends record their struggle to survive as New York crumbles around them.

programme.title: Blade
programme.desc: A half-mortal, half-immortal is out to avenge his mother's death and rid the world of vampires. The modern-day technologically advanced vampires he is going after are in search of his special blood type needed to summon an evil god who plays a key role in their plan to execute the human race.

programme.title: Blade II
programme.desc: Exploding from the pages of Marvel Comics comes the thrilling follow-up to the blockbuster "Blade." Half Man ... half vampire, and consumed by a desire to avenge the curse of his birth and save the human race from a blood-drenched Armageddon. In this newest action-packed adventure, Blade (Wesley Snipes) is forced to team up with the very vampires he hates in order to overcome a new type of monster which threatens to eradicate both races.

programme.title: Blade: Trinity
programme.desc: The war between humans and vampires continues, but the humans' best hope, human-vampire hybrid warrior Blade (Wesley Snipes), has been framed for countless murders, turning popular sentiment against him. The vampire leader responsible for Blade's bad publicity is Danica Talos (Parker Posey), who's determined to finally lead her bloodthirsty compatriots to victory. Now Blade must team up with a band of rogue vampire hunters (Ryan Reynolds, Jessica Biel) to save humanity.

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president (Cliff Robertson) is exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken (Kurt Russell) to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

programme.title: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: When a wealthy businessman follows a lead to find his missing brother, he dives headlong into a twisted underworld of squatters and vagrants that threatens to tear apart his family as he struggles to maintain his sanity.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Scientist Karen Ross (Laura Linney) is sent by her father-in-law, mogul R.B. Travis (Joe Don Baker), to the Congo to determine the whereabouts of his son's missing diamond-hunting team. Led by expert guide Kelly (Ernie Hudson), Ross and a mismatched search party -- including primatologist Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), treasure hunter Herkermer Homolka (Tim Curry) and a gorilla -- discover a danger far more sinister than anything they expected to find, even in the heart of the jungle.

programme.title: Brick Mansions
programme.desc: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice. Meanwhile, Damien and an ex-con named Lino (David Belle) work together to save the city from a plot to destroy it.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Recently promoted and transferred to the homicide division, Inspector Jessica Shepard (Ashley Judd) feels pressure to prove herself -- and what better way than by solving San Francisco's latest murder? However, as Shepard and her partner, Mike Delmarco (Andy Garcia), soon discover, the victim shared a romantic connection to her. As more of Shepard's ex-lovers turn up dead, her mind starts to become unstable, and she begins to wonder if she could be the very killer she's trying to track down.

programme.title: The Presidio
programme.desc: Ex-military policeman Jay Austin (Mark Harmon) is now a San Francisco detective. When his former MP partner is killed at a military base, he takes the case. But after arriving at the crime scene, he realizes he must look to his old rival, Lt. Col. Alan Caldwell (Sean Connery), for help. Austin then falls for Caldwell's daughter, Donna (Meg Ryan), further complicating matters. Still, the two men push on in their search, learning to respect one another as they pursue the killer.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Carl Lee Hailey (Samuel L. Jackson) is a heartbroken black father who avenges his daughter's brutal rape by shooting the bigoted men responsible for the crime as they are on their way to trial. He turns to Jake Brigance (Matthew McConaughey), an untested lawyer, to defend him. Brigance struggles to believe that he can get Hailey acquitted in this small, segregated Southern town, given Hailey's race and the deliberate nature of his crimes, but Carl has unshakable faith in him.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A quiet man and his son take in a wounded stranger near his homestead, along with a bag full of cash. The stranger claims he's a sheriff being pursued by outlaws, but the man can't be sure.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: A year and a half after the fall of civilization due to a viral outbreak, a former FBI agent is forced to protect a young woman immune to the disease from a dangerous gang leader hunting her.

programme.title: Afflicted
programme.desc: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turn to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up.

programme.title: Snake Eyes
programme.desc: Detective Rick Santoro (Nicolas Cage) has never played by the rules. When he attends a high-profile boxing match with his friend Navy Cmdr. Kevin Dunne (Gary Sinise), as well as Defense Secretary Kirkland (Joel Fabiani), he witnesses a terrorist assassinate Kirkland. Despite a lockdown on the arena, key witness Julia Costello (Carla Gugino) escapes -- and Santoro begins to suspect Kirkland's death is part of a much larger conspiracy that involves boxing rivals and a beautiful stranger.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Mike Sullivan (Tom Hanks) is an enforcer for powerful Depression-era Midwestern mobster John Rooney (Paul Newman). Rooney's son, Connor (Daniel Craig), is jealous of the close bond they share, and when Mike's eldest son, Michael (Tyler Hoechlin), witnesses a hit, Connor uses the incident as an excuse to murder Sullivan's wife (Jennifer Jason Leigh) and youngest son. Forced to flee, Sullivan and Michael set out on a journey of revenge and self-discovery.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: After a bite from a genetically altered insect gives him superhuman abilities, teenage loser Rick Riker (Drake Bell) decides to use his powers for good. Donning an uncomfortably tight costume, Rick becomes a mysterious crime fighter known as The Dragonfly. But standing in the way of truth, justice and the American Way is an evil villain known as The Hourglass, who plans to become immortal by sucking the life force out of anyone who gets in his way.

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation.

programme.title: Beau Is Afraid
programme.desc: A paranoid man embarks on a darkly funny and nightmarish odyssey to get home to his mother.

programme.title: In Her Skin
programme.desc: The parents (Guy Pearce, Miranda Otto) of a missing girl launch a frantic search for their daughter, unaware that the child's former baby sitter (Ruth Bradley) has murdered her.

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Found terrified and alone in rural Louisiana, Nell Sweetzer (Ashley Bell) is now safely in New Orleans. She can't remember the terrible events of the previous months, only that she is the only surviving member of her family. Nell wants to start a new life for herself, but just as she begins the difficult process, the evil force that once possessed her returns -- bringing with it unimaginably horrific plans that mean her last exorcism was just the beginning.

programme.title: The Crusades
programme.desc: Three friends set out for one last great weekend while dodging authority, love affairs, and violent foes.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: All the Wrong Ingredients
programme.desc: Desperate to win a high-stakes dessert contest, chef Ben unintentionally cooks up an imaginary friend to help him reinvent the meaning of delicious. But what happens when his ambition becomes a monster.

programme.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
programme.desc: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turn to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: This horror tale focuses on visitors to the secluded mansion of Hill House who have been called to the isolated location by Dr. David Marrow (Liam Neeson) as part of a study on insomnia. However, Marrow is really investigating fear, and he plans to scare the subjects, including the introverted Nell (Lili Taylor) and the seductive Theo (Catherine Zeta-Jones). Unfortunately for Marrow and everyone staying at Hill House, the manor is actually haunted by an evil spirit out to torment its guests.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turn to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908 an outlaw returns from years of hiding in Mexico to claim stolen gold hidden in the hills of Montana.

programme.title: Warrior Strong
programme.desc: Trying to save his career, a suspended professional basketball player returns home to coach his former high school team.

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe.

programme.title: Pelé: Birth of a Legend
programme.desc: Under guidance from manager Vicente Feola (Vincent D'Onofrio), young PelÃ© (Kevin de Paula) utilizes his street soccer skills to lead Brazil to the World Cup in 1958.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Project Almanac
programme.desc: David Raskin (Jonny Weston) is a high-school science nerd who dreams of going to MIT. When he and his friends (Sam Lerner, Allen Evangelista) find his late father's plans for a "temporal displacement device," David can't wait to start tinkering. When they finally get the device to work, the teenagers jump at the opportunity to manipulate time in their favor -- but their joy is short-lived when they begin to discover the consequences of their actions.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Agent Game
programme.desc: A CIA officer becomes the target of a rendition operation after being the scapegoat for the death of an interrogation subject.

programme.title: The Killer Inside Me
programme.desc: An encounter with an aggressive prostitute (Jessica Alba) brings a Texas lawman's (Casey Affleck) homicidal tendencies screaming to the surface.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Spunky and rebellious Becky tries to reconnect with her father during a weekend getaway at a lakefront house. But the trip soon takes a turn for the worse when convicts on the run, led by the merciless Dominick, suddenly invade the home.

programme.title: Afflicted
programme.desc: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, siblings Ellie (Christina Ricci) and Jimmy (Jesse Eisenberg) come across an accident on Mulholland Drive. As they try to help the woman caught in the wreckage, a ferocious creature attacks them, devouring the woman and scratching the terrified siblings. They slowly discover that the creature was a werewolf and that they have fallen victim to a deadly curse. Now that they have been sliced by the werewolf's claws, they will be transformed into werewolves themselves.

programme.title: The Bigfoot Trap
programme.desc: A journalist's life changes forever when he finds himself locked inside a bigfoot trap by an insane sasquatch hunter.

programme.title: Miles to Go Before I Sleep
programme.desc: The relationships between musicians and their road crews and the importance of the people who work to put shows together.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: The United States of Leland
programme.desc: A withdrawn young man, Leland Fitzgerald (Ryan Gosling) is imprisoned for the murder of a mentally disabled boy, who also happened to be the brother of his girlfriend, Becky (Jena Malone). As the community struggles to deal with the killing, Pearl Madison (Don Cheadle), a teacher at the prison, decides to write about Leland's case. Meanwhile, others affected by the murder, including Becky and her sister, Julie (Michelle Williams), must contend with their own problems.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold (Jason Bateman) seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie (Kristen Wiig). Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy (Mila Kunis), an employee. But what Joel doesn't know is that Cindy is a sociopathic con artist, and a freak workplace accident clears the way for her to ruin Joel forever.

programme.title: Adventureland
programme.desc: It's the summer of 1987, and recent college grad James Brennan (Jesse Eisenberg) can't wait to begin his long-anticipated dream trip to Europe. Unfortunately, James' plans come to a screeching halt when his parents announce that they are unable to subsidize his trip. Forced to take a job at the local amusement park, James prepares for the worst summer ever, until he finds love with a captivating co-worker named Em (Kristen Stewart).

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: O
programme.desc: Moving the classic tale of Othello onto the basketball courts of a high school, the story focuses on a young black man named Odin (Mekhi Phifer) who is convinced by a conniving best friend, Hugo (Josh Hartnett) that his girlfriend (Julia Stiles) is cheating on him. Of course, what Odin doesn't know is that Hugo is in fact motivated by his own jealousy of Odin's good fortune. It's a sticky situation in classic Shakespearean tradition.

programme.title: The Loved Ones
programme.desc: After a classmate (Xavier Samuel) declines her invitation to the school dance, a teenager (Robin McLeavy) kidnaps him and makes him the guest of honor at her own twisted prom.

programme.title: Beau Is Afraid
programme.desc: A paranoid man embarks on a darkly funny and nightmarish odyssey to get home to his mother.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

programme.title: All the Wrong Ingredients
programme.desc: Desperate to win a high-stakes dessert contest, chef Ben unintentionally cooks up an imaginary friend to help him reinvent the meaning of delicious. But what happens when his ambition becomes a monster.

programme.title: Gringo: The Dangerous Life of John McAfee
programme.desc: Filmmaker Nanette Burstein tries to unravel the strange behavior of John McAfee, who left his life as a software mogul to become a recluse in the jungles of Belize.

programme.title: Scrapper
programme.desc: Living alone in her London flat, 12-year-old Georgie must confront reality when her estranged father, Jason, shows up out of nowhere. Uninterested in a sudden new parental figure, she remains stubbornly resistant to his efforts. As they both adjust to their new circumstances, Georgie and Jason soon find that they still have a lot of growing up to do.

programme.title: The Aggressives
programme.desc: Filmmaker Daniel Peddle follows a group of masculine-presenting queer people of color who were assigned female at birth. They hide the feminine aspects of their bodies and often adopt male personas but don't always feel included or represented by the LGBTQ world.

programme.title: What Remains
programme.desc: A small town pastor is forced to reckon with an act of forgiveness when the convict he forgave for murdering his wife returns to town five years later, while the town sheriff investigates another murder that may be related.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A quiet man and his son take in a wounded stranger near his homestead, along with a bag full of cash. The stranger claims he's a sheriff being pursued by outlaws, but the man can't be sure.

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe.

programme.title: Piñero
programme.desc: Piñero tells the story of the turbulent and creative life of a Latino icon, the poet-playwright-actor Miguel Piñero (Benjamin Bratt), whose urban poetry is recognized as a precursor to rap and hip-hop. Piñero became a hero to many in both the theatrical and Latino worlds. But the resulting notoriety and fame was too much for the Latino bad-boy genius who died a premature death in 1988. His legend lives on.

programme.title: The Grifters
programme.desc: Hard-as-nails Lily Dillon (Anjelica Huston) works as a swindler for dangerous bookie Bobo (Pat Hingle), probably the only man she fears. Arriving in Los Angeles on business, Lily looks up her son, Roy (John Cusack), a small-time con artist content with paltry sleight-of-hand cheats. Roy's girlfriend, Myra (Annette Bening), looks like an All-American type but is a grifter looking to pull off another big-time con. The convergence of the three hustlers inevitably means trouble for all of them.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: Prophet's Prey
programme.desc: Filmmaker Amy Berg sheds light on the sexual, financial and spiritual abuses heaped upon members of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints by their former leader, Warren Jeffs.

programme.title: Loudmouth
programme.desc: Interviews and never-before-seen footage provide insight into the life of the Rev. Al Sharpton, the polarizing civil rights activist who spends decades fighting for social change.

programme.title: The House of Mirth
programme.desc: Lily (Gillian Anderson) is a ravishing socialite who quickly discovers the precariousness of her position when her beauty and charm start attracting unwelcome interest and jealousy. She seeks a wealthy husband and, in trying to conform to social expectations, she misses her chance for real love with Lawrence Selden (Eric Stoltz). Her quest for a husband comes to a scandalous end when she is falsely accused of having an affair with a married man and is rejected by society and her friends.

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years of My Life
programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorian (Griffin Gluck) has an epic imagination and a slight problem with authority, and these things collide when he transfers to a middle school where students are expected to follow the rules. This doesn't sit well with Rafe. With help from his new friend Leo (Thomas Barbusca), the mischievous lad concocts schemes to drive his tyrannical principal (Andy Daly) crazy while also using his charm and wits to impress a girl (Isabela Moner) and battle the bullies.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: The crew of the Starship Enterprise returns home after an act of terrorism within its own organization destroys most of Starfleet and what it represents, leaving Earth in a state of crisis. With a personal score to settle, Capt. James T. Kirk (Chris Pine) leads his people (Zachary Quinto, Karl Urban, Zoë Saldana) on a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction, thereby propelling all of them into an epic game of life and death.

programme.title: Geostorm
programme.desc: After an unprecedented series of natural disasters threatened the planet, the world's leaders came together to create an intricate network of satellites to control the global climate and keep everyone safe. But something has gone wrong, as the system built to protect Earth is attacking it and it becomes a race against the clock to uncover the real threat before a worldwide geostorm wipes out everything and everyone along with it.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Astronauts (Jake Gyllenhaal, Rebecca Ferguson, Ryan Reynolds) aboard the International Space Station are on the cutting edge of one of the most important discoveries in human history: the first evidence of extraterrestrial life on Mars. As members of the crew conduct their research, the rapidly evolving life-form proves far more intelligent and terrifying than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: The Friend

The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone
programme.desc: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Carl Lee Hailey (Samuel L. Jackson) is a heartbroken black father who avenges his daughter's brutal rape by shooting the bigoted men responsible for the crime as they are on their way to trial. He turns to Jake Brigance (Matthew McConaughey), an untested lawyer, to defend him. Brigance struggles to believe that he can get Hailey acquitted in this small, segregated Southern town, given Hailey's race and the deliberate nature of his crimes, but Carl has unshakable faith in him.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: The crew of the Starship Enterprise returns home after an act of terrorism within its own organization destroys most of Starfleet and what it represents, leaving Earth in a state of crisis. With a personal score to settle, Capt. James T. Kirk (Chris Pine) leads his people (Zachary Quinto, Karl Urban, Zoë Saldana) on a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction, thereby propelling all of them into an epic game of life and death.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

Unfortunately, James' plans come to a screeching halt when his parents announce that they are unable to subsidize his trip. Forced to take a job at the local amusement park, James prepares for the worst summer ever, until he finds love with a captivating co-worker named Em (Kristen Stewart).

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him.

programme.title: Kiss the Girls
programme.desc: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Notorious cat burglar John Robie (Cary Grant) has long since retired to tend vineyards on the French Riviera. When a series of robberies is committed in his style, John must clear his name. Armed with a list of people who own the most expensive jewels currently in the area, John begins following the first owner, young Francie (Grace Kelly). When her jewels are stolen, Francie suspects John, destroying their tentative romance. John goes on the lam to catch the thief and clear his own name.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Animal House
programme.desc: When they arrive at college, socially inept freshmen Larry (Thomas Hulce) and Kent (Stephen Furst) attempt to pledge the snooty Omega Theta Pi House, but are summarily rejected. Lowering their standards, they try at the notoriously rowdy Delta Tau Chi House, and get in. The trouble is, the college dean (John Vernon) has it in for the Deltas. He has put them on "Double Secret Probation" and secretly assigned Omega's president (James Daughton) the task of having their charter revoked.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Futuristic version of the fairy tale `Pinocchio', about a highly advanced robotic child who longs to become a real boy so he can win back the love of his adoptive mother who abandoned him. He journeys through a violent, dystopian world in a quest for the Blue Fairy who has the power to make his dream come true.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.title: The Golden Compass

Determined to rid himself of his pesky partner, he extracts his alter-ego's genes, but an accident and a dog hair see the later-ego take on his own life. Unaware of his existence, the man and his wife perfect their new rejuvenation formula and their fortune seems assured until his alter-ego steals it.

programme.title: The Tiger Rising
programme.desc: When a boy discovers a caged tiger in the woods near his home, his imagination runs wild as his life begins to change in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Money Train

Foster brothers John and Charlie have held a lifelong fantasy of robbing the network's money train, which collects millions of dollars each night from the city's subway stations. In addition to trying to deceive their boss, the boys must also contend with a beautiful new decoy cop.

Unaware of their military prowess, the shop keeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shop keeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

After a team of potential players has been recruited, former player Jimmy Dugan coaches the girls and prepares them for the World Series.

Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.desc: A curmudgeonly instructor at a New England prep school remains on campus during Christmas break to babysit a handful of students with nowhere to go. He soon forms an unlikely bond with a brainy but damaged troublemaker, and with the school's head cook, a woman who just lost a son in the Vietnam War.

Made up of a motley crew of rogues and mavericks, the top-secret combat unit uses unconventional techniques to battle the Nazis and change the course of the war.

After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story.
